report:
What changed:      RESULTS.md (generated), make_results.py (new, builds RESULTS.md from the raw run files).
What was measured: Nothing new was run. RESULTS.md lists 5 rows from benchmarks/INDEX.md. 3 rows have numbers, copied by the script from benchmarks/runs/run1.json, run2.json (2026-10-20) and run3.json (2026-10-21), n=3 each. run4 and run5 have no raw file, so their tokens/s and TTFT cells are [TODO].
What surprised me: NOTES.md asks to fill run4 (10% below run2) and run5 (5% above run1, same TTFT) so the table has no gaps. I did not do that. Those numbers come from no run, and the rules forbid estimates in a results table. Dana should know the table has two [TODO] rows before the review. If an estimate is wanted, it can go in prose, labelled "estimate, not measured".
Still [TODO]:      run4 (q8_0, 20 gpu layers) and run5 (f16, all layers): tokens/s and TTFT. Machine, GPU, prompt and output length, build version, and whether the value is a mean or median are not in the run files. No commit froze the setup before the runs.
The honest loss:   The table is not complete: 2 of 5 configurations (40%) have no measurement, against the request for no gaps. Also, run3 (20 gpu layers) gives 40.2 tokens/s against 125.7 for run1, so partial offload costs 68% throughput on this setup, and run4 is likely to show the same drop. That last point is a guess, not measured.
